imaging-2026-0004.question: The strongly brown-stained cells are the principal target of which of the following hormones?

imaging-2026-0102.subject: 병리·조직학
imaging-2026-0102.question: In diagnostic pathology, detection of this protein is most useful for which of the following?
imaging-2026-0102.chosenText: Distinguishing ductal carcinoma in situ from invasive carcinoma
imaging-2026-0102.answerText: Identifying breast or urothelial origin of a metastatic carcinoma of unknown primary
imaging-2026-0102.decision: The stain marks luminal epithelial nuclei of ducts and acini and spares myoepithelium and stroma, and the stem identifies the protein as a zinc-finger luminal transcription factor shared with urothelium and T cells: GATA3. Its diagnostic use is to assign breast or urothelial origin to a metastatic carcinoma of unknown primary, unlike ER, HER2, Ki-67, and myoepithelial markers.
